precepts.text: This is what the refiner's fire and the soap mean. And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the Lord, two parts therein shall be cut off and die: two out of every three of our people shall be cut off. But the third shall be left therein; and I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people; and they shall say, The Lord is my God. That is the wilderness right there.
precepts.point: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' soap. That is how you know it is the last days.

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

precepts.why:
“For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’ soap”. Christ is like a refiner's fire. Zechariah shows what that fire and that soap mean.

“And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the Lord, two parts therein shall be cut off and die”. Two out of every three of our people shall be cut off and die. Why? Because we know damn good and well.

“But the third shall be left therein.” There is going to be a third: one third will be saved out of this land, America. “And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried”. That is the refiner sitting over the silver in Malachi 3, purging the sons of Levi “as gold and silver”.

“They shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The Lord is my God.” That is the wilderness right there. That is how you know Malachi 3 is the last days: “who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth?” Only the third part that comes through the fire refined.

precepts.text: An officer connected it to losing patience in the trial: in the day of prosperity there is a forgetfulness of affliction, and in the day of affliction there is no more remembrance of prosperity. When things go well you forget what the low estate was like; take heed lest you fall. And when the heat gets turned up, you forget the last end, the increase the Lord is going to give you, and the things he has in store. If you would just purge your spirit, you would be able to receive all the things the Lord has promised; but you quit because you forgot what the goal was, you forgot the mission, so you want to abandon ship. Be patient in your lowest state and do not forget the prosperity to come; that strengthens your faith.
precepts.point: They shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The Lord is my God. That is how we get saved: as the Most High refines us and burns the iniquity out of us, as we overcome these trials. There is no other way: the fire on one side, the deep water on the other, and the only way through is the straight line. There are no shortcuts for our people; you have to take the long route, because the Most High has to prove you to see if you are worthy of a kingdom.

note.label: Forged by Fire

precepts.why:
Zechariah says, “I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried”. In that fire some want to quit, stop relying on the brotherhood and abandon ship. Sirach shows why: “In the day of prosperity there is a forgetfulness of affliction: and in the day of affliction there is no more remembrance of prosperity.”

In the day when things are going well, you forget what it was like to be in your lowest state, and you have to take heed lest you fall. And in the day of affliction, when the fire comes up and the heat gets turned up, you forget the prosperity: the last end, the increase the Lord is going to give you, the things he has in store.

The trying of your faith worketh patience, and Sirach 2 says, woe unto them that have lost patience. If you would just purge your spirit, you would be able to receive all the things the Lord has promised for the future. But you quit because you forgot what the goal was; you forgot the mission, so you want to abandon ship.

When you are going through that adversity, be patient in your lowest state and don't forget the prosperity to come. That is what strengthens your faith through the refining, until the Lord says, “It is my people: and they shall say, The Lord is my God.”

precepts.text: And then shall many be offended: in this purging process a lot of people are going to turn their back to the Lord. And that is what people forget: you are not turning your back to us; we are nothing but humble servants working together in the vineyard. You are turning your back to the Master, saying, I do not want to do the work anymore. And shall betray one another: when you turn your back to your brother, it is called betrayal. And many false prophets shall rise: the ones that say, I can do the work outside the body, I can do my own thing. If you were going to do the work somewhere else, why would you not do the work here? Because you were never going to do the work; you had no intentions of doing the work. And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold. But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved: that is the only way you get salvation. You have to walk through hell to get to heaven; there is no shortcut to the kingdom, no roundabout. You walk straight through, and if you do not want to do it, do not do it.

That is how we get saved: as the Most High refines us and burns the iniquity out of us, as we overcome these trials. There is no other way: the fire on one side, the deep water on the other, and the only way through is the straight line. note.label: Forged by Fire

precepts.why:
Zechariah says two parts shall be cut off and die and the third brought through the fire. We are still talking about the purge. Christ describes what the purge looks like among the people: “And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.”

In this purging process a lot of people are going to turn their back to the Lord. That is what people forget: you are not turning your back to us. We are nothing but humble servants of the Lord, working together in the vineyard. You are turning your back to the Master and saying, I don't want to do the work anymore. And when you turn your back to your brother, it is called betrayal.

“And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.” That is the one who says, I can do the work outside the body; I don't have to be here; I can do my own thing. If you were going to do the work somewhere else, why wouldn't you do it here and continue the mission? Because you were never going to do the work; you had no intentions of doing it. And they deceive the simple. A brand new fool with the Bishop's precept book starts his own thing, while leadership has laboured twenty-plus years to do this work, and other fools follow him.

“And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.” Iniquity, the short word is sin. “But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.” Fight until the end: that is the only way you get salvation. You have to walk through hell to get to heaven. There is no shortcut and no roundabout to the kingdom; you walk straight through. If you don't want to do it, don't do it.

precepts.text: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie. None of that is going into the kingdom. Even liars, people that deal falsely, that lie by omission, that hold back when they know exactly what you're asking them: the Lord marks that down too.
precepts.point: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; and shall thrust him through when he prophesieth. Why would his own father and mother do that? Because they will have already witnessed how Christ dealt with the rebellious. Once those parents see that Christ isn't playing, that's how the parents are going to be moving. I'm going back to you brothers and sisters with sons and daughters that refuse to change: don't put your life on the line for wickedness that refuses to repent.

note.label: In a Game of Fools Without The Rules

precepts.why:
Zechariah says the Lord will “cut off the names of the idols out of the land” and “cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.” This craziness on this side is not coming into the kingdom. Revelation shows who stays outside: “For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.”

Without the kingdom are dogs, meaning the other nations. Sorcerers: witchcraft. Whoremongers, murderers, idolaters: you are not getting the kingdom, and it is Christ saying it. And whosoever loveth and maketh a lie: if you even lie, your ass ain't going in.

That includes people that deal falsely: you ask them a question and they try to be slick with their answer, hiding things, lying by omission. That is what thou shalt not lie nor deal falsely means: holding back. Some of our kids lie right in your face, insulting your intelligence, acting like they don't know what you are really asking, as if the Lord isn't hearing it. The Lord is marking that down too; the angels heard it.

All of this is purged before we get to the kingdom. Zechariah's day is in the wilderness, right before we get to our kingdom, the same way the Lord purged us when we came out of Egypt: forty years in the wilderness until those who rebelled were wiped out. None of that evil is going to make it there.

precepts.text: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me. Everybody that's against what Christ said is an enemy of Christ, and that includes our people. You fathers and mothers are trying to rule over your children to keep them from going astray, and they say, I'm not having that; the hell with what you got to say. In the wilderness, Christ will be teaching the commandments face to face, and those still refusing, he said, bring them before me.

note.label: In a Game of Fools Without The Rules

precepts.why:
Zechariah says that when any shall yet prophesy lies, “his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live”, and “shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.” Why would his own father and mother do that? Because they will have already witnessed how Christ dealt with the rebellious. Christ said it: “But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.”

Everybody that is against what Christ said is an enemy of Christ, and that includes our people. You fathers and mothers try to rule over your children to keep them from going astray, and they say, I'm not having that; I'm doing my own thing; the hell with what you got to say, mama; the hell with that Bible. They refuse the correction of their fathers and mothers ruling over them, and they would not that Christ and his law should reign over them.

This happens in the wilderness. Christ will be teaching the commandments face to face, and some will still tell him, I ain't doing this, I ain't doing that. Christ said, bring them here, and kill them right in front of my feet.

Once those parents see that Christ ain't playing, that is how they will be moving: you want to put my head on the chopping block? You will die right now. So to you brothers and sisters with sons and daughters that refuse to change: don't put your life on the line for wickedness that refuses to repent. We pray our brothers and sisters get their minds right now, so they don't end up there.

note.label: In a Game of Fools Without The Rules

precepts.why:
Zechariah says, “In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.” What is the fountain? Paul shows it: “That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word”. The water is the word. The fountain opened to the nation of Israel is the Bible, the laws of the Most High.

In that day the laws of God will be opened up to the twelve tribes of Israel, with Christ there. It is for sin and for uncleanness: the lies, the wickedness and the evil will be opened up to be judged.

That day is in the wilderness, right before we get to our kingdom. It parallels Ezekiel, where the Lord pleads with us face to face and says, I will cause you to pass under the rod: the rod of correction. Christ will cause all of us, sons and daughters, mothers and fathers, to pass under that rod, washed by the word. If we have not learned to keep God's laws by then, that is the day of judgment.

That is why the names of the idols are cut off and no more remembered. When the Lord smites down the one teaching lies, everybody instantly drops what he taught; nobody talks about it anymore. The fountain of the word cleanses the nation, and everything that is not in line with this Bible is put to death with the ones that taught it.

precepts.text: Two parts shall be cut off and die, but the third shall be left.
precepts.point: Carmel was Judah's and Bashan was Manasseh's.

note.label: Jubilee: The Year To Be Set Free

precepts.why:
Isaiah 49:20 speaks of “The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other”. The ones we lost are the two thirds, here in America. In case somebody asks what that means, Zechariah shows it: “And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the Lord, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.”

Notice it says in all the land. The land it is talking about is Babylon, and that is America. So two out of every three Israelites shall die here in America. The ones we lost are them wicked Israelites.

Then the third: “And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The Lord is my God.”

That remnant is who goes back to possess the land in Obadiah. And even after the two thirds are gone, the children that are left shall say, “The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.” The land will still be too narrow for the ones God brings back.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 14 Part 2

precepts.why:
“And it shall come to pass, that in all the land”: land is singular, not plural; it is talking about Babylon first and foremost. “Two parts therein shall be cut off and die”: two out of every three of us ain’t no damn good, and it is talking about the Israelites, not Edom, not Moab and Ammon. So examine yourself day by day: am I murmuring, am I gossiping, do I have hatred for my brother or sister? Paul said in Philippians, not in my presence only but much more in my absence. That is why many on Facebook don’t want to be with a camp or a congregation: so nobody can check their wickedness. The two parts are the ones that say, Lord, we cast out devils in thy name, and he says depart from me ye workers of iniquity; the ones who leave and say stop teaching Christ was black, or you don’t have to keep Passover the way the Bible says.

“But the third shall be left therein. And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried”: a lot of brothers and sisters that bounce never get tried; they leave the fire before they are purified, before they get rid of the leaven, the bitterness, the envy, the malice. “They shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The Lord is my God.”

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

precepts.why:
This explains the rest of the dead that live not again. “And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the Lord,” Do you see the word land right there? It doesn't say lands. It says in all the land: that is talking about one particular land, Babylon the great. “two parts therein shall be cut off and die;” Two out of three of us shall be cut off and die here in Babylon. “but the third shall be left therein.”

“And I will bring the third part through the fire,” That is the key: through the fire. That fire is not just a spiritual fire; that fire is a literal fire. Revelation 18:8 shows it: she shall be utterly burned with fire.
